note: Curated groups for the web UI: features that were found worth turning on. 'tested' names the Antigravity version on which the effect was seen in the client; null means the effect is known from the client's page code only and was not seen. 'uiPatch' names a component that agy-flags adds to the client's page script, because the public build has the flag but not the component. 'feature' names a feature of agy-flags itself that no flag of the client stands for (config.features); 'requires' are flags of another group that it needs, which are turned on with it and are left on when it is turned off. Titles are short; 'description' and 'risk' are one plain sentence each, for people who do not read code.

description.zh: 在设置里多出 Developer 页，可以在客户端里自己覆盖界面开关。
description.en: Adds a Developer page to Settings, where you can override interface flags inside the app.

risk.zh: 本工具停止运行时，Antigravity 窗口一刷新就只显示报错文字，要等本工具恢复或客户端重启。
risk.en: While agy-flags is not running, a reloaded Antigravity window shows only an error text until agy-flags runs again or the app restarts.

description.zh: 在输入框旁显示上下文已经用了多少；重启后还要在 Settings → Appearance → Advanced Settings → Chat Layout 里打开「Context and quota indicator」。
description.en: Shows how full the context window is next to the input box; after the restart, also turn on "Context and quota indicator" under Settings → Appearance → Advanced Settings → Chat Layout.

description.zh: 每条回复下面多一个 $ 按钮，点开能看到这一轮用了多少 token、多少命中了缓存；费用要打开「估算费用」才有数字。
description.en: Adds a $ button under each reply that shows the tokens of the turn and how many came from the cache; costs show numbers only with "Estimated costs" on.

riskLabel.zh: 依赖本工具运行，连接 models.dev
riskLabel.en: needs agy-flags running, connects to models.dev

risk.zh: 本工具停止运行时，Antigravity 窗口一刷新就只显示报错文字；另外它每天最多一次从 models.dev 下载价格表，不带你的任何数据。
risk.en: While agy-flags is not running, a reloaded Antigravity window shows only an error text; also, once a day at most, agy-flags downloads a price list from models.dev, without any of your data.

description.zh: 按 models.dev 上的公开价格，把回复用量里一直显示 $0 的费用算出来，只是估算，不是账单。
description.en: Fills in the costs in the token usage, which otherwise always show $0, from public prices on models.dev; an estimate, not a bill.

risk.zh: 本工具停止运行时，Antigravity 窗口一刷新就只显示报错文字，要等本工具恢复或客户端重启。
risk.en: While agy-flags is not running, a reloaded Antigravity window shows only an error text until agy-flags runs again or the app restarts.

description.zh: 把 Antigravity 的按钮、菜单和设置页显示成中文，对话内容不翻译，打开或关掉后要重启。
description.en: Shows the buttons, menus and settings of Antigravity in Chinese; conversations are not translated, and a restart is needed.

risk.zh: 本工具会换掉起标题请求里的一句指令，你的消息原样发出。
risk.en: agy-flags replaces one sentence of the instruction in the title request; your message goes out unchanged.

description.zh: 新对话的标题用中文起，不用重启。
description.en: New conversations get Chinese titles instead of English ones, with no restart needed.

description.zh: 可以从对话的任意一步分出一个新对话。
description.en: Lets you branch a new conversation off any step of a conversation.

description.zh: 换成按状态分组、带收件箱模式的新侧边栏；关掉后分组如果还是 Status，到 Display Options → Group By 选回 Project。
description.en: Switches to a new sidebar that groups conversations by status and has an inbox mode; if grouping stays on Status after you turn it off, set Display Options → Group By back to Project.

description.zh: 可以把对话放进自己建的分组里。
description.en: Lets you put conversations into groups you create.

description.zh: 在设置里多出 Running 页，列出所有还在运行的后台任务和终端。
description.en: Adds a Running page to Settings that lists all background tasks and terminals that are still running.

description.zh: 可以在 Chat Layout 设置里把 Markdown 工件调宽或铺满。
description.en: Lets you make Markdown artifacts wider or full width in the Chat Layout settings.

description.zh: 查看文件时可以用别的应用打开它。
description.en: Lets you open the file you are viewing in another app.

description.zh: 查看文件时，侧栏多出工件列表和文件筛选框。
description.en: Adds an artifact list and a file filter to the sidebar of the file pane.

description.zh: 输入框的「Add context」菜单里多出连接器入口。
description.en: Adds connectors to the "Add context" menu of the input box.

description.zh: 可以给单个对话关掉遥测，是否真的少报了数据没有核实。
description.en: Lets you turn telemetry off for a single conversation; whether less data is really sent was not checked.

description.zh: 听写可以限定识别哪几种语言。
description.en: Lets you choose which languages dictation recognizes.

description.zh: 子代理可以用模型菜单里的任意模型，你在消息里点名时代理才会换。
description.en: Subagents can use any model of the model menu; the agent switches only when you name one in your message.

description.zh: 输入 /review-agent，让一个子代理只读地审查你的改动并列出问题。
description.en: Type /review-agent to have a subagent review your changes without touching them and list the problems.

description.zh: 输入 /deepagent，让一个子代理把复杂问题查到底并反复验证，配额花得更多。
description.en: Type /deepagent to have a subagent dig into a hard task and double-check its answer, at a higher quota cost.

description.zh: 输入框里没发出去的文字，重启后还在。
description.en: Text you typed but did not send is still there after a restart.

description.zh: 在项目设置里可以填 GitHub 令牌，并限制代理能做哪些 GitHub 操作。
description.en: In the settings of a project you can add a GitHub token and limit what the agent may do on GitHub.

title.zh: 鼓励代理用交互小部件

description.zh: 提示代理在需要图示时，在对话里做可交互的 HTML 小部件。
description.en: Tells the agent to show interactive HTML widgets in the conversation when a picture would help.

description.zh: 插件市场可以按类别筛选，结果按热门程度排。
description.en: The plugin marketplace gets category filters and lists the most popular plugins first.

description.zh: 插件市场的卡片上显示有多少人在用。
description.en: Plugin cards in the marketplace show how many people use them.

risk.zh: 代理可以读取并操作这台 Mac 上的其他应用，只在你信任当前任务时让它做。
risk.en: The agent can read and operate other apps on this Mac; let it act only for tasks you trust.

description.zh: 让代理派子代理操作这台 Mac 上的应用；打开后要重启两次，第一次用时按提示授予辅助功能和屏幕录制权限。
description.en: Lets the agent send a subagent to operate apps on this Mac; restart twice after turning it on, and give the Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions when asked.

riskLabel.en: takes over the screen, mouse and keyboard

risk.zh: 子代理可以用你的鼠标、键盘和整个屏幕，每次接管前会先问你。
risk.en: The subagent can use your mouse, keyboard and whole screen; it asks you before each takeover.

title.en: Computer use: take over the screen

description.zh: 让电脑操作还能用你的鼠标、键盘和整个屏幕，它工作时别碰电脑，一碰就会停。
description.en: Lets computer use also work with your mouse, keyboard and whole screen; do not touch the Mac while it works, or it stops.

risk.zh: Teamwork 一次开好几个子代理，主对话用贵的模型时配额会成倍消耗。
risk.en: Teamwork starts several subagents at once, so with an expensive main model it uses quota many times faster.

title.zh: Teamwork 子代理不强制用 Flash
title.en: Teamwork subagents not forced to Flash

description.zh: Teamwork 启动的子代理不再被强制改用 Flash，可以和主对话用一样的模型。
description.en: Subagents started by Teamwork are no longer forced onto Flash and can use the same model as the main conversation.
